_doc: How often the company wakes (its tempo). Source of truth for company/tools/cadence.js (copied to company/work/ops/cadence.json at founding); guide: docs/TEMPO.md. Base values (the owner's): dispatcherTickMin = the self-paced dispatcher loop's sleep between ticks (company/tools/dispatcher-loop.js re-reads it every iteration); defaultCooldownMin = rest between two dispatcher wakes of one seat when the seat sets no cooldownMin; maxPerTick = most loops the dispatcher starts in one tick. seats.<stationId> may set loopEvery (minutes or a 5-field cron: the seat's own loop routine schedule), cooldownMin, priority, wakeOnInbox, wakeOnOwnerMessage, peakOk (owner only: allow a loop clock inside a provider's peak-price block); `cadence.js apply` writes them into loops.json and the station. bounds and tempo are owner-set: inside bounds (and tempo.mode bounded-auto) the crew may make a temporary change that expires after tempo.autoExpireMin, at most one per tempo.minChangeIntervalMin; outside bounds is the owner's, or a harness-change.js --kind schedule --target cadence.json proposal reviewed by finance, risk and people. temporary = the active crew change (cadence.js writes it). Env DISPATCH_COOLDOWN_MIN / DISPATCH_MAX_PER_TICK still override at run time.
